about: What each glossary term means, for whoever translates the catalogs (tools/translate.py, i18n/README.md). The terms themselves are the glossary.* keys of every catalog: one glossary for all languages, each language its own column, stamped like any other string.

terms.glossary.account: a Claude sign-in; the hub keeps several of them in a pool
terms.glossary.agent: a permanent session of the hub with a role, its own profile and tools
terms.glossary.asleep: a session that has finished and does not run; it can be woken
terms.glossary.backlog: the list of a direction's tasks not done yet
terms.glossary.bus: the hub bus: messages between the hubs of different people
terms.glossary.card: a question card on the page or in Telegram: the owner answers it by choosing an option
terms.glossary.catalog: a list of plugins to install from (a marketplace)
terms.glossary.compaction: Claude Code compressing a long conversation into a summary (/compact)
terms.glossary.contact: an entry of the owner's address book
terms.glossary.core: the hub's engine, as opposed to its modules and plugins
terms.glossary.critic: a second model that tries to refute a draft
terms.glossary.direction: a long-running stream of work with its own board and lead session (a workstream); not a compass direction, not instructions
terms.glossary.executor: a temporary session raised for one task: it hands the task in and falls asleep
terms.glossary.feed: the stream of a session's messages and steps on the page
terms.glossary.gateway: the hub's local proxy that sends the model requests through the active account
terms.glossary.gist: the one line about what a session does now, shown in the list of sessions
terms.glossary.hand_in: an executor finishes its task and reports the result
terms.glossary.hub: the product and its main session: the coordinator the owner talks to, which runs the fleet; a loanword is fine where the language uses one
terms.glossary.lead: to lead a direction: the session in charge of it
terms.glossary.lessons: the block of an executor's result with what is worth remembering for next time
terms.glossary.liaison: the session that handles this hub's correspondence with other hubs over the bus
terms.glossary.limit: the usage limit of an account (for 5 hours, for a week)
terms.glossary.mini_hub: a session that leads its own group of executors, a small hub inside the hub
terms.glossary.module: an optional part of the core with its own manifest (Module API)
terms.glossary.owner: the person whose hub it is, the user; neutral, of any gender, never 'master'
terms.glossary.plugin: an extension of the page or of Claude Code, installed from a catalog
terms.glossary.pool: the accounts the hub switches between when a limit runs out
terms.glossary.relay: the server that carries bus messages between hubs
terms.glossary.restart: stopping and starting the hub or a part of it again
terms.glossary.result: what a session reports at the end of its turn
terms.glossary.session: one running Claude Code or Codex conversation that the hub manages
terms.glossary.sign_in: logging in to Claude or to a service
terms.glossary.specialist: a permanent professional agent with its own profile; it raises executors for its tasks
terms.glossary.task: a piece of work given to a session
terms.glossary.theme: the look of the page (colors, fonts)
terms.glossary.token: a sign-in secret, or a unit of model usage — by the context
terms.glossary.turn: one round of a session's work: from a message to its result
terms.glossary.update: a new version of the hub, which installs itself
terms.glossary.wake: to start a sleeping session again
terms.glossary.watchdog: the core's check of the sessions' results and stalls
